mobile.look: Drag or swipe to look around

navigation.jump: Click red orbs to jump to new locations

search.title: Search
search.useSearch: Use the search bar at the top to find locations
search.destination: Yellow rotating square marks your destination
search.path: Blue path guides you to your destination

help.title: Help

homepage.howToUseText: Welcome to CampusVirtual! Start your virtual tour by selecting one of our suggested starting locations below, or use the search box to find a specific location. Use your mouse to look around, and the arrow keys or WASD to navigate through the campus. Click on hotspots to learn more about different areas.
homepage.outdoorsDescription: Start your tour from the campus entrance
